subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The ending was better because she had waited.”?
options: Entertainment can open the door to history, but careful reading must walk through it.
Emma did not stop reading last pages forever, but she understood why some journeys need uncertainty.
A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
